question: In which state is the Bhitarkanika National Park located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhitarkanika National Park** is located in the state of **Odisha**, India.
 
• The park is renowned for its **mangrove forests**, which are among the largest in India.
 
• It is spread over an area of approximately **145 square kilometers**.
 
• **Bhitarkanika** is home to a variety of wildlife, including the **saltwater crocodile**, which is one of its major attractions.
 
• The park also boasts a rich biodiversity with several species of **birds, reptiles, and mammals**.
 
• It is a significant habitat for **migratory birds** during the winter season.
 
• The region is also known for the **Bhitarkanika Wildlife Sanctuary**, which surrounds the national park.
 
• The park is situated in the **Kendrapara district** of Odisha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Jharkhand**__

 __
 
• Jharkhand is known for its **mineral resources** and rich cultural heritage.
 
• It is home to the famous **Betla National Park**.
 
 
 
• **Manipur**__
 __
 
• Manipur is famous for its unique **Loktak Lake** and the floating islands called **phumdis**.
 
• It is home to the **Keibul Lamjao National Park**, the only floating national park in the world.
 
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu**__
 
 
• Tamil Nadu is known for its rich **temple architecture** and cultural heritage.
 
• It is home to the **Mudumalai National Park** and the **Indira Gandhi Wildlife Sanctuary**.
